_finding: A receipt is a file somebody handed you. Its own hash proves only that nobody edited it after it was made, and anyone can make one: write a verdict, serve a list that hashes to what it claims, rehash the receipt. The one thing that ties a receipt to us is where its list is served from, so the origin is pinned. Without the pin, our own checker printed "The receipt holds" over an impostor's bytes, and fetched the author's URL from the reader's machine.

mutations.name: a receipt may name any archive it likes
mutations.expect: FAIL a receipt pointing anywhere but our archive fails, and nothing of the author is fetched

mutations.name: the pin accepts plain http and a look-alike host
mutations.expect: FAIL ...and the pin is the site itself by default, over https only

mutations.name: a list URL on our origin but outside the frozen lists is accepted
mutations.expect: FAIL a list URL on our origin but outside the frozen lists fails

mutations.name: the list chain is not checked
mutations.expect: FAIL a Base receipt over a list our archive serves as Robinhood's fails on the list's chain

mutations.name: the receipt fields are not checked
mutations.expect: FAIL a rehashed receipt with an impostor verdict over a listed field fails on its fields before anything is fetched
